summary: The uniform proof dichotomy 'a principal 3/4 block has sigma_min>=c OR some physical cut has a rank>=3 cross block' is false. For A_m=e0e0^T+u_mu_m^T-v_mv_m^T with two disjoint m-coordinate flat directions, kappa_*(A_m)=1/m while every physical cross block has rank<=2. This does not refute QFORM: the same family has a bounded continuous density with ||p||_infinity<=pi*sqrt(2). A mixed localized/diffuse third mechanism is required.
